text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Now this here is a batch of
pickled
radishes.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've always been so fond of these. I have
a mash
back at the dorm I use to make
them.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When I served them up for dinner once,
the
crunchy little things became the talk
of the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I meant to make plenty enough to go
around, but
lately I always seem to find
myself running low.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They're all growing girls, I suppose. We
wouldn't
want anyone going hungry, so
I'll be making a
mountain of pickles
today!
